study: V99 R106 phase 19 — BULL+LOW_VOL BROAD_ADVANCE short-veto audit

precommitment.hypothesis: inside causal BULL+LOW_VOL BROAD_ADVANCE, F7 shorts may systematically fight broad market appreciation while longs remain healthy
precommitment.candidate_action: veto only short exposure inside BROAD_ADVANCE; never choose side after seeing results
precommitment.train_gate: long aggregate ROI>0/PF>1/tail-robust and >=3 healthy folds; short aggregate ROI<0/PF<1/tail-negative and >=3 harmful folds
precommitment.promotion_gate: candidate must Pareto-improve F7 on train, untouched holdout, full path, severe and supersevere exact replay; >=3 train folds nonharmful

trade_diagnostics.episode_definition: contiguous nonzero post-trade position with unchanged sign; same-sign resizing stays in one episode; inherited and still-open boundary episodes are excluded
trade_diagnostics.transition_hour_note: asset P&L, fees and funding come from the exact replay. For diagnostic episode segmentation, a sign-flip hour is attributed to the newly opened sign. This can slightly move per-trade quality statistics but does not change equity, ROI, drawdown, days, costs, or regime path returns. A future promotion candidate must use an exact transition-split ledger before final freeze.
